page_title: LIL 2-1 TOU | Lille v Toulouse 14/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+8' 2 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Osame Sahraoui plays it into the box, and Ethan Mbappe (Lille) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 2:1.
90+6' Jeremy Stinat shows a yellow card to Chancel Mbemba (Lille) for his blatant foul.
90+2' Toulouse work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+1' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.
90' 1 - 1 Goal! Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Guillaume Restes into the bottom right corner.
89' Substitution. Frank Magri (Toulouse) is replaced by Mario Sauer.
89' Here comes a substitution. Dayann Methalie is given a rest as he is replaced by Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse).
89' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
88' Frank Magri (Toulouse) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
87' The Lille players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
86' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Lille! Let's see what he decides.
86' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
86' Referee Jeremy Stinat has finally had enough of Carles Martinez and brandishes a yellow card at him!
85' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) will take a corner kick.
83' The booking goes to Olivier Giroud (Lille).
80' A substitution has been made. Ayyoub Bouaddi is replaced by Nabil Bentaleb (Lille).
80' Bruno Genesio has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Osame Sahraoui (Lille) replacing Felix Correia.
80' Substitution. Mathias Fernandez-Pardo leaves the pitch and is replaced by Ethan Mbappe (Lille).
80' The ref signals that VAR has overturned that yellow card and upgraded it to a straight red for Alexis Vossah (Toulouse). He’s got to go!

80' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Alexis Vossah (Toulouse), but referee Jeremy Stinat must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
77' Benjamin Andre (Lille) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
75' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) will deliver the corner kick.
74' Surely that's handball by one of the Toulouse players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
73' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.

72' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom left corner. Berke Ozer is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. It will be a corner kick for Toulouse.
72' Here is a change. Abu Francis is going off and Carles Martinez gives the last tactical orders to Alexis Vossah (Toulouse).
72' Substitution. Rafik Messali walks off the pitch and Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) comes on as a substitute.
65' Rafik Messali (Toulouse) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
65' A goal, which was scored by Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille), was disallowed due to offside.
61' Bruno Genesio decides to make a substitution. Ngalayel Mukau will be replaced by Hamza Igamane (Lille).
60' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
60' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) will take the free kick.
56' That's a clear yellow card. Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) goes into the book.
56' That's a free kick to Toulouse.
55' Romain Perraud (Lille) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
55' That will be all from Santiago Hidalgo who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Rafik Messali (Toulouse).
54' Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle. Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) commits a foul after dangerous play.
50' 0 - 1 An unlucky rebound falls to Frank Magri (Toulouse) and he scores with a bullet header.

50' Crossbar! Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from around the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball crashed against the bar!
50' The corner is swung in but Toulouse can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
50' A brilliant through ball from Aron Donnum (Toulouse) as he picks out Frank Magri, who darted into free space to take the pass.

47' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Olivier Giroud (Lille) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Guillaume Restes pulls off a brilliant save.
46' Lille enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Problems for Bruno Genesio as Alexsandro is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Chancel Mbemba (Lille) replaces him.
45+1' Romain Perraud plays a lovely pass into Ngalayel Mukau (Lille), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly over the crossbar.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Alexsandro (Lille) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
44' The game is interrupted now, Alexsandro (Lille) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
41' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
39' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
39' Alexsandro (Lille) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
38' Romain Perraud (Lille) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
37' Benjamin Andre (Lille) tries to find Olivier Giroud, but he puts too much power on the pass.
33' What a chance that is! Aissa Mandi swings the ball into the box, and Olivier Giroud (Lille) gets in front of his man and powers his header just over the bar.
32' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) latches on to a cross to head the ball wide of the net. A poor header.
24' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) is about to take a corner kick.
24' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lille.
23' Olivier Giroud (Lille) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
23' What was Aron Donnum (Toulouse) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
18' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
17' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. Lille are awarded a corner kick.
14' Romain Perraud (Lille) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
11' The referee blows his whistle, Lille are awarded a corner kick.
8' Nathan Ngoy (Lille) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
8' Alexsandro (Lille) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Felix Correia (Lille) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
3' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
2' Romain Perraud (Lille) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
1' The Lille players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lille will have the kick-off.
Jeremy Stinat is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
